## Emphasis

Plain text, **bold text**, __bold with underscores__, *italic text*, _italic with underscores_, and
`inline code`. Mixed: **bold with *italic* inside**, *italic with `code` inside*, and
**bold with a [link](https://example.com) inside**.

Snake_case_words_should_stay_plain, and so should 2*3*4 arithmetic and a lone * asterisk.

Inline code keeps its symbols: `**not bold**`, `*not italic*`, `[not a link](nowhere)`.

## A long paragraph

Markdown viewers live or die on long paragraphs, because wrapping, line height and letter spacing all
show up at once. This paragraph runs on deliberately so you can try **Settings → Line spacing** and
**Letter spacing** and watch it reflow live. It also mixes in some *emphasis*, a bit of `code`, and a
[link to the tables page](02-tables.md) so the styled runs land in different places on each line as
the window narrows. Resize the window slowly: the text should re-wrap smoothly, the side margins
should shrink in narrow windows, and in wide windows the column should stop growing at a comfortable
reading width and simply center itself. Keep going, because one more sentence makes sure this wraps
to at least five or six lines even in a very wide window, which is what the resize check needs.

Short paragraph after the long one.

A line ending in two spaces  
forces a line break inside the same paragraph.
